const Profile::MESG* Profile::GetMesg(const FIT_UINT16 num)
{
    static FIT_UINT16 index[65536] = {};
    static FIT_UINT16 maxnum = 0;

    if (num > maxnum)

    const FIT_UINT16 v = index[num];
    return v ? &mesgs[v - 1] : NULL;
}
